Question #1: Flu Vaccine and Herd Immunity

metadata.title: Question #1: Flu Vaccine and Herd Immunity

sections.text: In the past I didn't get a flu vaccine. I get pretty nervous around needles and have fainted in the past when having blood drawn for testing, so I didn't want to put myself in that position. I also thought that I'm only affecting myself by not getting the vaccine each year. My question is, is there a herd immunity factor to flu vaccines? – Thanks, Eyal Sion
’'Voiceover: It's time for Science or Fiction.

sections.text: Item #1: A new paper demonstrates how it is possible to have negative energy.[5]Item #2: Scientists have created nanoengineered silver which they claim is 42% stronger than the strongest steel alloy.[6]Item #3: A new prototype bionic leg has detailed sensory feedback sufficient to allow users to walk blindfolded.[7]
What we hope ever to do with ease, we must learn first to do with diligence.– Samuel Johnson (1709-1784), English writer
